leadText: (Japanese: ポケットモンスターB・W グッドパートナーズ Pocket Monsters BW: Good Partners) is a Pokémon manga authored by Kyouichi Shichigatsu and illustrated by Chiyo Kenmotsu. The manga is based on the games .
